articleTitle: A model used in mutual funds performance evaluation based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The evaluation and selection of funds are a classification problem essentially. The paper builds evaluation index sets including fund companies, fund managers, risk level and the level of risk-adjusted earnings, and uses independent samples t-test, linear regression and KPCA and SVM model to evaluate and classify securities investment funds. According to the empirical analysis, the model is practicable, and using this way to choose funds is simple, straight, and practical.

articleTitle: Continuous improvement actions: Moderating effects of the consciousness of employees
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Continuous Improvement (CI) will continuously improve the company level innovation capability and becomes one of the most important strategies to maintain the manufacturing competitiveness. According to the data of Continuous Innovation Network (CINet), this paper studies the process of continuous improvement and the moderating effects of the continuous improvement consciousness of employees on continuous improvement actions. The results show that the consciousness of employees has significant moderating effects on the relationships between the motivation of operation level and the incentive practices, and has significant moderating effects on the relationships between the coordination practices and the operation level performance. Finally, according to the results of the theoretical research, the suggestions on the implementation of continuous improvement are provided.

articleTitle: Financial system security analysis based on macro finance perspective
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In the macro-finance perspective, the financial industry and financial security is viewed as an integrated system, and should be studied based on the idea of system theory. In this paper, we discuss the composition of China's financial industry system security, and the fuzzy uncertainty of the security of the financial system, random uncertainty and complex coupling uncertainty analysis. We also establish the basic framework of the security of the financial system modeling and optimization, and introduce the idea of financial system dynamics. At last, we discuss on the financial system security and reliability of the SD flow chart analysis. The result of the paper contributes to China's financial system security and optimization.

articleTitle: Research on the factors affecting the successful borrowing rate of P2P network lending in China — Taking the case of renrendai online lending as an example
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The problem of financing of minor enterprises has been a difficult problem all over the world, but the emergence of Internet finance gives them a new chance. However, the success rate of P2P network lending has been maintained at a low level. This paper takes the case of Renrendai Online Lending as an example, firstly illustrates the selection of model and uses binary Logit model to do regression test. Further, the Crystal ball software is used to do Monte Carlo simulation. Finally, it gives suggestions and possible solutions from the perspective of lenders and borrowers.

articleTitle: Innovating the new model of academy-locality cooperation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Adhering to the “innovative technology transfer mode, regional economic development service” concept, with the help of Internet thinking, CAS innovation park has opened up a new path and has explored a new model of academy-locality cooperation, which has become the output of academy resources, the bridge between scientists and entrepreneurs, and the new engine leading the development of local economy.

articleTitle: Financial repression and bank risk-taking behavior: Evidence from listed commercial banks in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: As a signal of emergence of market-oriented interest rate policy, People's Bank of China (PBOC) deregulated bank loan prime rates in 2013. This leads commercial banks should be serious concern about interest rate risk management. The aims of the study is to examine the influence of financial repression on bank risk-taking on the basis of a sample of 16 listed commercial banks in China spanning the period from 2008 to 2014. The study employs independent variables of required reserve ratio, deposit prime rate and loan prime rate as proxies of financial repression and dependent variables of non-performing loan ratio, total risk and Z value to measure bank risk-taking behavior. The empirical results of the study indicate that required reserve ratio has negative effect on bank risk-taking. Deposit prime rate has positive effect on bank risk-taking, whereas loan prime rate has negative effect on bank risk-taking.

articleTitle: Study on the mutual spatial effect between urbanization and service industry agglomeration: Empirical analysis based on Chinese Provincial Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: There is a double multiplier effect between urbanization and service industry agglomeration, and the interaction between urbanization and industrial agglomeration is realized through inter industry linkage. Based on the Chinese Provincial Panel Data from 1985-2013 and the measurement in the Eastern, Central and Western regions urbanization level and service industry agglomeration degree, by constructing a simultaneous equations model, respectively making three stage least squares regression analysis to the mutual spatial effect between the urbanization level and the service industry agglomeration in Eastern, Central and Western regions from 1985-1996 and 1997-2007, 2008-2013. The result shows that the correlation of the mutual spatial effects between different stages of urbanization and service industry agglomeration in Eastern, Central and Western regions of China existed differences. The service industry agglomeration degree of the Central and Western regions compared to the Eastern region more lower, similar characteristics showed in the urbanization development level. In the different stages, resources supply and the potential of the market scale play positive roles in promoting service industry agglomeration, the spatial effect of opening-up to service industry agglomeration is not obvious. Compared to the railway construction, the highway construction brings greater effect to the urbanization level. The level of industrialization is related to the local economic growth and industrial structure adjustment.

articleTitle: International comparisons on business model of agriculture e-commerce between India and China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The article gives a comparative study on business model of agricultural e-commerce correlative of both basis framework and system flows between India and China. It finds out the common characteristics in development, and analyzes its differences and limitations, which is necessary to provide insights and references for the development of agricultural information and agricultural e-commerce in China.

articleTitle: Research on the resource integration of virtual industry cluster based on the complex network theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Under the cyber-society environment, the information resource shows an explosive growth trend, so how to more effectively achieve the integration and sharing of these resources and create greater benefits has become the most important issue faced by the virtual industry cluster. The enterprises within the virtual industry cluster establish complex connection between each other through the social behavior of resource integration, and some studies have showed that these complex connections form a criss-cross resource integration network of the virtual industry cluster, showing typical complex network characteristics. This paper intends to analyze the virtual industry cluster under the ecosystem of cyber-society by drawing on the complex network model, and use the characteristic path length and clustering coefficient to characterize the resource integration efficiency and clustering degree of the virtual industry cluster. It aims to provide a new analysis idea to promote the resource integration and development of the virtual industry cluster.

articleTitle: Study on situation, problem and countermeasure in the development of banking industry
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Nowadays, the competence and controlling power of banking industry in our country are at a rather high level and relies little on the outside world and it runs in a fine state generally. However, banking industry begins to face to severe challenges with the Economy's entering the new normal, interest rates liberalization reform, the crash of internet finance and the internalization of RMB, we have to accelerate transformation development, perfect supporting policies, recreate the traditional banks and fasten the service globalization, only in this way can the banking industry develop in a safe, stable, healthy and rapid way.

articleTitle: Systemic risk, financial security and the financial holding companies of China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In the context of China's implementation of the mixed operation of financial industry, the financial risks also accumulate and gradually increase. The stability of the banking system play important role in the financial security. We employ the systematic marginal expected loss method to calculate the risk accumulation degree and the contribution rate of each bank in the international financial crisis based on the open market data. We also analyze the systematic risk conduction path and the optimum model of the financial holding companies in China.

articleTitle: An analysis of the asymmetric-information translation service market in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Globalization has enhanced the demand for information-exchange, which has also encouraged the development of translation service industry. Currently, the studies of translation service industry and its market have based on the information symmetry hypothesis. The quality of translation service is only known to the provider, which belongs to an asymmetric information situation; therefore, the translation service market may become lemon market if the providers take advantage of the information asymmetric. This paper uses the lemon market theory by Akerlof to find the reasons and solutions for the lemon market of translation service in China.

articleTitle: Economic analysis of the gender discrimination in employment under the background of universal two-child policy
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The universal two-child policy has been adopted since the fifth Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China. This policy is in response to the problem of aging of population in China so that the pressure of our country's economy, people's living and other aspects can be alleviated. However, what should not be ignored is that the policy has lead to the increase of the gender discrimination in employment. How to protect the legitimate rights and interests of women workers, realize social harmony and sustainable development, we need scientific knowledge and actively respond to female employment discrimination. In this paper, I will find out the root causes and economic explanations of this gender discrimination in employment and then put forward the countermeasures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Transformation strategy of the three industries in China at the Lewis turning point
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: At the first stage of Lewis, China promoted rapid development of industrialization driven by huge demographic dividend. But under the institutional constraint, the labor force in non-agricultural industries flows back into the countryside constantly. In 2004, China had entered into the Chinese-style Lewis turning point. Under the Chinese-style Lewis turning point, the three industries in China has three characteristics: low efficiency in the primary industry, overcapacity of the second industry, the rapid development of the tertiary industry. In order to improve production efficiency of the primary industry, China should implement effective policies to promote the rural population urbanization, and at the same time encourage urban capital to flow to the countryside. In order to increase the strength that economic development is driven by demand, China should optimize the distribution structure of national income through the government means such as reduction of tax and transfer of profits.

articleTitle: The impact and measures of industrial hollowing-out on China's economic structural adjustments under the new normal
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Industrial hollowing-out is a kind of objective existence and phenomenon, as well as a process of metabolism which represents sending off old industries while welcoming the new in the development of industry. As every sword has its two edges, industrial hollowing-out is no exception. Seizing the new strategic opportunities of “the Silk Road Economic Belt and the 21st-century Maritime Silk Road” and “the Yangtze River Economic Belt”, we should take advantages of the positive aspects of industrial structural adjustments and avoid their harmful sides to the development of economy, in order to optimize the industrial structure, maintain the industrial safety, and further promote the development of China's economy healthily and steadily, especially under the new normal.

articleTitle: Analysis on Hangzhou commercial spirit: Characteristic of Hangzhou time-honored brand and contemporary hangzhou entrepreneurs
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Hangzhou has a reputation which was rarely known; that is, one of the most vibrant city in private economy. Behind this reputation, there is a group of wise businessmen. As a part of Zhejiang Merchants, Hangzhou Entrepreneurs have their own characteristics and culture. The commercial culture of Hangzhou has a long story. Hangzhou Entrepreneurs, from Hu Xue-yan with spirit of “No-deceiving” to Ma Yun with the spirit of “Dream, Passion and Responsibility”, always remain excellent traditions and cultural deposits. This article investigated and analyzed the development status and characteristics of Hangzhou Time-honored Brand, compared with contemporary Hangzhou Entrepreneurs to excavate the core connotations and cultural heritage of Time-honored Brand, and explore the core spirit of contemporary Hangzhou Commercial Spirit. Furthermore, the article analyzed the connotations and superiorities of Hangzhou Commercial Spirit under the influence of urban culture, and explained its essence.

articleTitle: The effect of classification shifting on accruals and cash flow
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of the economy, scholars have found that earnings managements are widespread in Chinese market. However, the classification shifting earnings management has been found in developed market and Chinese scholars did not do many researches in this field and the understanding is still limited, especially the effect of classification shifting on accruals and cash flow has not been study yet. Therefore, we use Chinese A-share listed companies to test the classification shifting existing and the impact of the earnings quality from accruals and cash flow that can be the index for the affections. Through the empirical results, we can know classification shifting is confusing to investors and the reaction of accruals may be lower in market to make the stock price mispricing in coming years. In a word, this paper fill in the blank of the research of classification shifting, and call the regulators and investors' concerns of classification shifting earnings management in corporations.

articleTitle: Demulsification mechanism of simulated liquid production in the polymer-surfactant flooding process
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: As a new type of oil displacement agent, the compound of polymer-surfactant has a strong ability of increasing viscosity, emulsifying, etc. Results of the field test showed that the polymer-surfactant flooding can enhance oil recovery by 18.8% above water flooding. Field test showed that compared with polymer flooding, the settling time of the produced liquid of polymer-surfactant flooding is longer, and dehydrated electricity is higher, so it is more difficult to handle the produced fluid which has a higher requirement for adaptability of dehydration system of water and polymer flooding. To improve the matching techniques of polymer-surfactant flooding and get a satisfied demulsification result to ensure the produced liquid of polymer-surfactant is separated effectively, the demulsification and demulsification mechanism is studied. The results showed that, the demulsification effect of the non-ion polyether demulsifier is better than the cation polyether demulsifier, and the demulsification effect of the HLX-2 demulsifier which is a non-ion polyether demulsifier is the best. When the concentration of the HLX-2 demulsifier is 50mg/L, the oil content in water is 257mg/L, the water cut in oil is 28%, and the demulsification ratio is 92.5%. Increasing the content of the polymer-surfactant, the oil-water interfacial shear viscosity is increased, the demulsification is more and more difficult, and the demulsification effect of the HLX-2 demulsifier is getting worse and worse. Results showed that, polymer-surfactant molecule in the oil-water interface was replaced by the demulsifier HLX-2, and the interfacial shear viscosity and interfacial elastic modulus was reduced, and the stability of the emulsion was declined. Increasing the concentration of the demulsifier HLX-2, the replacement role enhanced. So the demulsification mechanism of the nonionic polyether demulsifier is that interface membrane is replaced. After the molecule of the demulsifier replaced the emulsifier, the strength of interfacial film was reduced, and the molecular of the demulsifier can also “catch” a few emulsion droplets, resulting in more than one droplet was coalesced, and the purpose of fast-breaking was achieved.

articleTitle: Analysis on pressure of digital technology brings to the print media industrial security
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Digital technology accelerated its penetration in fields of national economy, the great development of digital technology brought some opportunities to the publishing industry, such as updating the developing concept of the traditional publishing industry, changing the expression form of the products and attracting more capital injection to add the vitality, digital technology promoted integration between traditional media and new media, with good potential and prospects for development. At the same time, digital technology brought great pressure to the publishing industry security, and then, many problems followed: uneven distribution of interests, lack of innovation, lack of technical standards, laws and regulations lag, copyright security issues highlighted and regulatory difficulties, shortage of talent, and so on. In order to maintain the security of publishing industry, it should be pay attention to research and development, and further improve the level of digital technology. Technology should be used to industry protection, the public's copyright awareness need to strengthened, the development of the publishing and media industry will get improved.

articleTitle: Definition and statistical classification of language service industry
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Language service industry is an emerging industry in China and around the world. The concept and nature of language service industry has not been clearly defined and has not been included in the national industry classification system by many countries, including China. This paper thus intends to identify the activities as an industry and clearly define the industry from the perspective of industrial economics. Then it discusses how to put the industry into China's Industrial Classification for National Economic Activities (CISIC), while making references to the classification of the industry by North American Industry Classification System (NAICS), International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities (ISIC), as well as European Standard Classification of Productive Economic Activities (NACE). It is of great significance to define the term and get the activity listed in the industry classification system to help build an understanding of how the industry is structured and promote the further development of the industry.

articleTitle: Analysis of the changes of drug control law of the people's Republic of China from the aspect of the security of pharmaceutical industry (II)
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In this paper, the main content is to analyze the amount of Chinese medicine industry policies and regulations. And by analyzing the total annual quantity of policies to point out the macro-control from Chinese Government. And continue analyzing the paper (I) in this meeting last year.

articleTitle: Research on the allocative efficiency of the internal capital market and connected transactions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: According to the principal-agent theory, the asymmetric information theory and the internal capital market theory, this paper establishes a theoretical analysis framework, and then analyzes the theoretical relations and differences between connected transactions and the internal capital market. Based on the related theoretical analysis, this paper uses a sample of actual controllers in Chinese groups of the A-share non-financial listed companies in Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchange from 2011 to 2014, to empirically study on the allocative efficiency of the internal capital market and connected transactions. The results show that, connected transactions and the internal capital market have very close theoretical relationship; connected guarantee transactions and connected lease transactions reduce the internal capital market's allocative efficiency, but connected sales transactions and connected capital transactions not affect. This paper innovatively inspects how four types of connected transactions influence the internal capital market's allocative efficiency, which provides a new research perspective and vital analysis foundation.

articleTitle: A study on the safety of China's auto industry under the new normalization
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Auto industry is fund-intensive, technology-intensive and talent-intensive. According to the development history of the world economy and auto industry, auto industry plays an important supporting role both in developed countries and developing countries. This paper first analyzes the status of China's auto industry in the world. The international status of energy saving and new energy automobile industry in China and the present situation of domestic development are analyzed. Then, this paper lists several problems existing in China's auto industry. At the end of the article, four strategies are given.

Author Keywords: energy saving and new energy vehicles

articleTitle: From the view of field theory, the basic role of cross urban rail commuting service in metropolitan area — A case study of Beijing, Sanhe and Yanjiao
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper investigates the necessity and property of building cross - domain urban subway transit in China from the field theory. Then put Beijing, Yanjiao and Sanhe for example to construct the time coordinate model, which is suitable to China's national condition, by the properties of the field decreasing with time distance to illustrate the basic function of cross domain city rail commute in metropolitan area construction. Finally, we extended the conclusion on other Chinese metropolitan construction and how to alleviate the problem of ghost town then put `give priority to urban rail transit' as a policy suggestion.

articleTitle: Research on the internal income difference of the informal employment personnel
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: According to the China statistical yearbook data of 2014, the informal employment people have accounted for 53.4% of the total population of urban employment. At the same time, the income differentiation also occurred in the internal of informal employment. So this paper makes a research on the income of the informal employment through the Gini coefficient and regression analysis. We classify the informal employment people, while the study found the income difference is not so big. And all their work status, gender, area, skill level and other factors have significant influence on income.

articleTitle: Financial openness and bank performance: The case of China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Financial openness is one part of economic globalization, which has been a defining trend in the world. In this study, the aim of our research is to investigate the impact of financial openness on the performance of Chinese commercial banks. The data of the first 5 big Chinese commercial banks have been analyzed for the period of 1997–2013. Two approaches have been taken: one is PCA, which helps to build the Financial Openness Index; the other is PLS to estimate the impact of financial openness on Chinese banks performance. Result shows that a slightly positive relationship between financial openness and commercial bank performance. Furthermore, increasing the lever of bank deposits and controlling the scale of commercial banks can also play an important role in increasing commercial bank performance.

articleTitle: A study on the performance of water listed corporation using BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Water is of great significance in the industrial development and structural adjustment of economy in China. Urban water affairs have become one of the most important urban infrastructure existing to support the entire economic and social development. Urban water industry is under reforming in our country the past two decades and it has achieved great results. Government supports privatization of water industry greatly and the rapid growth of urban water affairs accelerate enterprise size and income. In recent years as China's water problem is getting worse, the public pay close attention to the environment and the performance issues of water companies cause more and more general concern of the government, the public and investors. Therefore, to assess performance of water companies has become increasingly necessary. This paper intends to select the larger water companies in the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and the Shanghai Stock Exchange, the 25 water companies, in period of 2011-2014. Based on the research status at home and abroad, the paper evaluates the performance of water listed companies based on DEA and BP neural network method. At last, we test the predictive ability of the network, and the network is conducted accurately.

articleTitle: Simulation research of industrial enterprise total profits based on the neural network of ARIMA
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Industrial enterprise total profit is the important indicator to measure the status of industrial economic sentiment over a given period of time, and also the first indicator for researching the macroeconomic early-warning. In this paper, the ARIMA neural network model is built, through the ARIMA theory combined with neural network theory, using 1997-2015 monthly time series data of the industrial enterprise total profit, to carry out the simulation research of the industrial enterprise total profit. First of all, make the seasonal adjustment for industrial enterprise total profit, to get rid of the seasonal factors of industrial enterprise total profit in the time series. Secondly, to emulate the 1997 ~ 2015 monthly industrial enterprise total profit by ARIMA neural network model, the simulation results show a good simulation training effect. Finally, using ARIMA neural network model to carry on the simulation of the industrial enterprise total profit from January to June in 2016, finally get the simulation values of industrial enterprise total profit from January to June in 2016.

articleTitle: Research on inventory control model and algorithm for commercial coal logistics park
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Coal logistics park has been an important infrastructure for coal logistics, its inventory management is important, but difficulty. The paper analysis the feasibility of logistics park transforming service pattern to business pattern, studies the importance of inventory control. By analyzing the composition of inventory, it creates a new inventory control model with a number of parameters containing coal washing rate and cycle. The result shows that new inventory control model is the extension of classical Economic Order Quantity Model, the order cycle is the monotonic increasing function of product for washing rate and raw coal achieve frequency, and the order quantity is the monotonous decrease function of product for washing rate and raw coal achieve frequency. They are all related to the raw coal washing rate, not related to washing cycle.

articleTitle: Research on optimal mixed health insurance contact based on risk sharing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Public health insurance led by the government is characterized by its compulsory attendance, generality and mutual aid, while commercial health insurance holds professional, competitive and profitable features. These two kinds of health insurance are different in objective, nature and characteristics. This paper, by means of mathematical model and numerical simulation, has proved that mixed health insurance contact can achieve the optimal social welfare based on risk sharing so as to complement their own advantages. At last, this paper has put forward the corresponding advice as to how to decrease the moral hazard in the selection of the ranks of hospital as well as the number of medical service.

articleTitle: Research on traveler information service system industrialization in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Traveler Information Service System (TISS) is an important part of intelligent transportation system (ITS). TISS industry is to serve the travel purpose, and use the information technology in travel information acquisition, transmission, processing and publishing activities of the industry. In order to effectively and efficiently develop TISS and industrialize TISS products in China, the government has focused on TISS industrialization strategies. This paper discusses the behavior structure and operation mechanism of TISS industry, and analyzes the present situation and main problems of TISS industry in China. Finally some macroscopic developing suggestions related to industrial policies are proposed.

articleTitle: Study on the development situation of Chinese cultural industry cluster
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Cultural industry agglomeration refers to the interrelated cultural enterprises and related organizations in geographical spatial agglomeration. Chinese cultural industry agglomeration is the result of government guidance. By setting up a national or local cultural industry park or demonstration base, government prompts cultural industry cluster areas to take shape. Cultural industry agglomeration effect, and have a profound impact on Chinese culture industry. It enhances the scale and influence of cultural enterprises and improves the international competitiveness of Chinese cultural industry. But at the same time there are also cultural industry hollowing out problems that needs the government and enterprises to strengthen management and guidance, seek the path of the cultural industry agglomeration, and strengthen the healthy development of cultural industry agglomeration.

articleTitle: A comparative study on the competitiveness of the film industries between Beijing and London based on the new diamond model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper aims to compare the film industries with the new diamond model by analyzing human resources, the basic economic strength in demand conditions and the supported industries and related industries, the government role and knowledge absorption and innovation between Beijing and London. Thus we may draw the conclusion of the disadvantages on film industry of Beijing and give relevant suggestions in order to enhance the competitiveness of Beijing Film and television industry and set a good sample for this field in other places.

Author Keywords: Film Industries Of Beijing and the London

articleTitle: The employment effect of minimum wage in dual economy
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This article studies the employment effect of minimum wage under the dual economy from the two aspects of theoretical research and empirical analysis. Theoretical research shows that under the urban-rural dual economic structure, the employment effect of minimum wage presents obvious asymmetry. However, the empirical analysis about the employment of peasant workers and the minimum wage in Beijing shows that the growth of minimum wage has a negative effect on migrant workers' employment. Then we give some reasons to explain the result.

articleTitle: Model of network embeddedness, knowledge sharing and service innovation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Due to the increasingly less differences between physical products, most enterprises have implemented differentiated marketing with the point of view of service to avoid intense price competition with rival makes, which lets service play an increasingly important role in the cultivation of competitive advantage. However, service innovation activities often require complex knowledge and resources. On the one hand, many core knowledge and resources are not usually owned by a single enterprise, but embedded in the relationship network. On the other hand, knowledge sharing provides an important role in the information or resource acquisition and the service innovation realization of enterprise. Therefore, this paper introduces the intermediate variables of knowledge sharing, and constructs a conceptual model to analyze the influence of network embeddedness on the service innovation of enterprises.

articleTitle: Analysis on the industrial competitiveness of beijing based on the shift-share analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: At present, China's reform of the supply front during the new normal is a comprehensive strategic deployment that involves various aspects including industries, macro control, capital and the fiscal and taxation systems. Beijing as the capital has been in the forefront of reform. But there existed many problems in industrial structure in Beijing. The optimization and upgrading of the industrial structure of Beijing is the core of the government's new round of supply side reform. Elimination of excessive production capacity and industrial optimization and reorganization is the key to the current round of supply side reform. Based on SSM model, it discusses the status of industrial structure and industrial competitiveness of Beijing City. In this paper, we discuss the status of industrial structure and industrial competitiveness of Beijing City, and then determine the direction of industrial development in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the development and utilization industries for “Urban Mineral Resources”
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The concept and category of Urban Mining Resources development and utilization industry were defined clearly, and the domestic industry and development status and trends are analyzed. It is in favor of feeling the pulse of the national industrial strategy layout, focusing on the direction of industrial development. The problems existing in the cultivation and development of the mining industry are analyzed. Finally, the policy orientation for promoting healthy development of the industry was put forward.

articleTitle: The impacts of FDI on publishing and media industrial security of China under the new normal
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the opening development of China's publishing and media market, foreign direct investment has been widely infiltrated into almost all the fields of the publishing and media industry. Foreign direct investment will give positive impacts on optimizing the allocation of the publishing and media resources, improving the publishing efficiency, and adjusting the industrial structure. While to some extent, it brings negative impacts on human resources, markets, industrial capital, and cases of looting excellent cultural resources have been found. To effectively protect the safety of China's publishing and media market, we should regulate the access rules of foreign direct investment, improve the investment and financing system, establish and improve the risk prevention mechanism of foreign direct investment.

articleTitle: The economic effect analysis of PPP model in urban rail transit — Illustrated by the London Underground and Beijing Metro Line 4
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Public Private Partnership is a new financing model and has been used in constructing public facilities. In this way, government attracts social capital to reduce the financial burden, enterprises earn revenue through private investment, and both of them ultimately achieve a win-win outcome. However, successful implementation of the PPP model requires us to balance many factors. This paper analyzes the failure of the London Underground PPP project and the success of Beijing Metro Line 4 and makes some suggestions, hoping that it can be served as a reference for the implementation of PPP projects in the future, better promoting the construction of public facilities.

articleTitle: How does rail transit promote the sustainable development of Beijing metropolitan area?
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The main objective of the paper is to study how the rail transit system promotes the development of Beijing metropolitan area. The paper finds Beijing is in a critical period to develop metropolitan area and commuter railway by analyzing the evolution of Beijing city spatial structure and rail transit. Then, it analyses how rail transit promote the Beijing metropolitan area from the perspective of stations, lines and network using the “Points-axis” theory by comparing with the Tokyo metropolitan area. Results shows that in the guide of the multi-level rail transit system which includes urban subway as the principal axis within the radius of 0-15km, light railway as the secondary axis within the radius of 15-30km, commuter railway as the tertiary axis within the radius of 30-70km, Beijing metropolitan area in the future, therefore, will form the reasonable spatial structure in which core area within the radius of 0-15km is the center, new cities such as Shunyi, Tongzhou and Daxing within the radius of 15-30km will be sub-centers and satellite towns includes Pinggu, Yanjiao and Guan within the radius of 30-70km.

articleTitle: Influence of government and market on the relationship between institutional change and Chinese total factor productivity
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Chinese economists always pay much attention on how to improve Chinese total factor productivity and make it to be driving factor of Chinese economic growth. Based on the provincial panel data from 1997 to 2011 of 29 provinces (cities, districts) in China, here, we did empirical research on the effects of mandatory institutional change and induced institutional change on Chinese total factor productivity. The induced institutional change and mandatory institutional change was represented by the China marketization index which was proposed by the Fan et al. and preferential policy index, respectively. The results show that the influence of the institutional change on Chinese total factor productivity is heterogeneity. Mandatory institutional change has significant positive effects on Chinese total factor productivity, while induced institutional change has negative effects. These findings indicated that mandatory institutional change dominated by the government is an important reason to promote Chinese total factor productivity, which means the government plays an important part in the process of institutional change. Our study has important implication on how to properly handle the relationship between government (“visible hand”) and market (“invisible hand”) under the new normal and how to coordinate the relationship between the decisive role of market in the allocation of resources and the role of government on economic growth.

articleTitle: Risk assessment and control of inland ships navigation safety — A case study of Shanghai inland waters
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the statistic, this paper summarizes the main idea of safety service with the theory of shipping service supply chain. By analyzing the water transport safety condition of Shanghai inland waterway, the paper gives a comprehensive analysis from the four aspects which are liveware, hardware, software and environment. And this paper builds an evaluation model and presents the comprehensive assessment of risks of navigation safety in Shanghai inland water by means of multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation based on AHP Method (Analytic Hierarchy Process Method), and makes a scientific forecast and analysis about safe ship navigation in the future. Finally, this paper puts forward countermeasures and suggestions on risk control.

articleTitle: Comparison study on the industrial policies of additive manufacturing in U.S. and China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Accompanying the “re-industrialization” strategy and the foundation of the National Network for Manufacturing Innovation(NNMI), the U.S. Government regarded additive manufacturing(AM) technology as the most promising one and mapped out series of policies to enhance the development of the industry. Meanwhile, top-level plan of advanced manufacturing industry is deployed in China, promoting AM industry to national strategic level. This paper is aimed at the AM industry policies of U.S. and China, making comparison analysis on strategic arrangement, technology road-map and support policies, and proposes suggestions on industrial structure, distribution, technology, organization, financial, and support policy.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: CSR, strategy and financial performance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"CSR, Strategy and Financial Performance"
by Sewei Wang and Xian Xiao
in the Proceedings of the International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS), July 2016

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper contains content from the paper(s) cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Coporate Social Responsibility, Strategy, and Firm Performance
by Joanna L. Ho, Fu-Hsuan Hsu, Chia-Ling Lee
in the Proceedings of the 27th Asian-Pacific Conference on International Accounting Issues


Prior studies report mixed findings on the relationship between corporate social responsibility (CSR) and financial performance. This paper argues that the relationship between CSR and corporate financial performance also depends on whether firms incorporate their strategic orientations (i.e., prospector vs. defender) into CSR activities. At the same time, divide CSR into “public CSR” and “internal CSR” instead of focusing on aggregate CSR as usual. This article selects the data of 728 manufacturing listed companies in China from 2010 to 2014, exploring the relationship between CSR and corporate financial performance with corporate strategy. Our results show that prospectors engaging in public CSR can get better performance than defenders. However, defenders that invest in internal CSR perform better than prospectors.

articleTitle: International comparisons on economic effects of social security level between Chile and China by demographics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: It is increasingly acknowledged that fundamental social insurance system both contains social insurance payment structure of diversified sources, and greatly relies on national investment capacity, financial market development and the growth of economic power by analysis of present relevant elements on social insurance system. It proves that effective operation of social insurance systems is directly related to native demographic characteristics by visual statistics. This paper assesses similar problems and disadvantage influences on the development of fundamental social insurance system by comparison of macro-economic and socioeconomic indexes between Chile and China. The thesis applies to the solution to imbalance crisis of pension insurance, and reveals the significance of long-term prediction of visual statistics.

articleTitle: Study on China's new industrialization (NI) level measurement
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Basing on our existing theory and measurement methods of the new industrialization(NI), this article has built a system of China's new industrial measurement indicators. By applying the datum from 2005 to 2014, we estimate the level of development and current status of China's NI, and evaluate the measurement results by establishing Hierarchical Linear Model (HLM). At last, we confirmed that our country's new industrialization is in the rapid development trend. And due to the difference of initial conditions in NI development there is a greater imbalance. In contrast, a region with poor initial condition of has a relatively fast development speed.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis of Hebei industrial structure and features
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In the face of all sorts of environmental problems, it is necessary to promote the optimization and adjust the industrial structure in order to realize the strong growth in industry and the better environment. The industrial structure of Hebei Province in 2014 is analyzed by using the factor analysis method in the paper. And all the indicators were summarized out four factors. They are the scale, efficiency, management and market factors. And the indexes of energy consumption and water withdrawals will be considered to analyze the characteristics of industrial structure completely.
